manual v0.1

Baseline guidance for designing and building software in Python: module and package boundaries, dependencies and environments, entry points, types and data, exceptions, concurrency and cancellation, interfaces and seams, configuration, external boundaries, and testing.

Adopt and deliver this manual

From an initialized project, adopt the manual explicitly, then deliver it at the project's declared user-scope skill targets:

garage config add manual python
garage skills install
garage skills verify

The CLI delivers builder-garage-manual-python as a skill. Installation alone does not make the guidance apply: the project's configuration must adopt it. Manuals are guidance, not workflow requirements or configuration files. See how manuals are used.
